name: DocuSeal secure template with API-aware defaults

steps.title: Web service - Front service
steps.subtitle: Point the template at your DocuSeal hostname.

steps.title: Web service - Upstream server
steps.subtitle: Send traffic to the DocuSeal container on port 3000 and let its JSON API errors reach clients unchanged.

steps.title: HTTP - API and upload constraints
steps.subtitle: Allow the REST verbs DocuSeal uses and keep both body limits above your largest payload. MAX_CLIENT_SIZE also drives ModSecurity's SecRequestBodyLimit.

steps.title: Security - Rate and connection limits
steps.subtitle: Limits per client IP, sized for the signing and admin pages.

steps.title: Security - Headers and error pages
steps.subtitle: DocuSeal sends its own nonce-based Content-Security-Policy, so BunkerWeb keeps it instead of replacing it.

steps.title: Performance - Client optimisation
steps.subtitle: Compress proxied responses; static files are served by DocuSeal, not BunkerWeb.
